description: Find football (soccer) matches and their current market odds by team, league, or both. Returns each match's kickoff time (UTC), status, home/draw/away probabilities, a match_id and its frontofgoal.com page. Use it for questions like "when do Arsenal play next?", "what Premier League games are on this weekend?" or "what's on today?". With no team or league it lists the most-traded matches. Use when "recent" for results from the last three days.

league.description: A league or cup: its id from list_leagues (e.g. "premier-league"), its name ("La Liga") or a common short name ("EPL", "UCL", "MLS").

team.description: A team name as people say it, e.g. "Arsenal", "Man Utd", "Real Madrid", "PSG".

when.description: Time window. today and tomorrow are UTC days; live is matches in play; recent is the last three days.

name: find_matches

odds.description: Home, draw and away probabilities; null when the market has no price.

best_ask.description: Lowest price someone will sell at now, 0 to 1.

best_bid.description: Highest price someone will pay now, 0 to 1.

probability.description: Implied probability from the market price, 0 to 1.

quoted.description: True when both a bid and an ask are standing, so the price is live.

result.description: For finished matches: home, draw or away.

status.description: scheduled, in_play, finished, awaiting_result, postponed, cancelled, abandoned or suspended.

note.description: Why the list is empty or cut short, and what to try.

title: Find matches
